description: This file contains geohash helper functions for geographic calculations, including bounding box estimation, distance calculations, and radius-based area coverage, with references to geohash encoding/decoding and neighbor computations.

methods.name: geohashEstimateStepsByRadius
methods.description: Estimates the number of steps (bits precision) for radius queries based on range and latitude.

methods.name: geohashBoundingBox
methods.description: Calculates the bounding box around a point given a radius in meters.

methods.name: geohashGetAreasByRadius
methods.description: Returns a set of geohash areas covering a radius around a point.

methods.name: geohashGetAreasByRadiusWGS84
methods.description: Wrapper for geohashGetAreasByRadius using WGS84 coordinates.

methods.name: geohashAlign52Bits
methods.description: Aligns a geohash bits structure to 52 bits.

methods.name: geohashGetDistance
methods.description: Calculates the great circle distance between two points using the haversine formula.

methods.name: geohashGetDistanceIfInRadius
methods.description: Checks if the distance between two points is within a radius.

methods.name: geohashGetDistanceIfInRadiusWGS84
methods.description: Wrapper for geohashGetDistanceIfInRadius for WGS84 coordinates.
